57: /*! 
58:   Returns True if (x,y) is in button
59:   \arg \c  button the button
60:   \arg \c  x x coord
61:   \arg \c  y y coord
62: 
63:   \return  True if pt (x,y) is in button, False otherwise
64:   \author  jfpatry
65:   \date    Created:  2000-09-17
66:   \date    Modified: 2000-09-17
67: */
68: static bool_t in_bbox( button_t *button, int x, int y )
69: {
70:     return (bool_t) (
71: 	( x >= button->pos.x ) &&
72: 	( x <= button->pos.x + button->w ) &&
73: 	( y >= button->pos.y ) &&
74: 	( y <= button->pos.y + button->h ) );
75: }
